bibl.title: Tell Farama (Pelusium). Roman City on the Mediterranean Coast.
bibl.seg: Krzysztof Jakubiak, Tell Farama (Pelusium). Roman City on the Mediterranean Coast.

Grażyna Bąkowska-Czerner & Rafał Czerner (edd.), Greco-Roman Cities at the Crossroads of Cultures. The 20th Anniversary of Polish-Egyptian Conservation Mission Marina el-Alamein (Oxford, 2019) pp. 109-124, figg.
bibl.note: Tell Farama (Pelusium) is one of the most important archaeological sites situated on the Sinai Peninsula. An attempt at reconstructing how the city was planned and how it functioned is the main subject of the analysis. Many relicts that have already been excavated serve as a visual manifestation of a flourishing ancient city and give the possibility to research and reconstruct how this urban organism functioned and how it developed during the few centuries at the beginning of Common Era.
